thingsYouShouldKnow: DigitalDSA Pro is a B2B intelligence platform built exclusively for Direct Selling Agents, loan brokers, Corporate DSAs, and Bank RMs.
This platform does not provide loans to individual consumers. For borrower-facing loan comparison and tools, visit our consumer portal.
All lender policies, interest rates, and eligibility criteria displayed are sourced from official bank publications and may change without notice.
Loan approval, disbursement, and terms remain at the sole discretion of the respective lending institution.
Agent commissions, payout structures, and incentive programs vary by lender and are governed by individual DSA agreements.
Refer to our Terms and Conditions for detailed information on platform usage, data handling, and partner obligations.
By using this platform, you acknowledge that you are a licensed loan intermediary and agree to our professional code of conduct.
